vtrmc-2022-01.prompt: Give all possible representations of $2022$ as a sum of at least two consecutive positive integers and prove that these are the only representations.

vtrmc-2022-02.prompt: Let $A$ and $B$ be the two foci of an ellipse and let $P$ be a point on this ellipse. Prove that the focal radii of $P$ (that is, the segments $\overline{AP}$ and $\overline{BP}$) form equal angles with the tangent to the ellipse at $P$.
vtrmc-2022-02.answer: The external bisector $\ell$ of $\angle APB$ meets the ellipse only at $P$ (reflect $A$ in $\ell$ to $A'$; for $Q\ne P$ on $\ell$, $QA+QB=QA'+QB>A'B=PA+PB$), so $\ell$ is the tangent.

vtrmc-2022-03.prompt: Find all positive integers $a,b,c,d$, and $n$ satisfying $n^a+n^b+n^c=n^d$ and prove that these are the only such solutions.
vtrmc-2022-03.answer: Either $n=3$ and $a=b=c=k-1$, $d=k$ ($k\ge2$), or $n=2$ and $\{a,b,c\}=\{k-2,k-2,k-1\}$ as a multiset, $d=k$ ($k\ge3$).

vtrmc-2022-04.prompt: Calculate the exact value of the series $$\sum_{n=2}^\infty\big(\log(n^3+1)-\log(n^3-1)\big)$$ and provide justification.

vtrmc-2022-05.prompt: Let $A$ be an invertible $n\times n$ matrix with complex entries. Suppose that for each positive integer $m$, there exists a positive integer $k_m$ and an $n\times n$ invertible matrix $B_m$ such that $A^{k_mm}=B_mAB_m^{-1}$. Show that all eigenvalues of $A$ are equal to $1$.
vtrmc-2022-05.answer: Similar matrices have the same eigenvalues, so $\{\lambda_i^{k_mm}\}=\{\lambda_i\}$ as multisets; pigeonhole makes each $\lambda_i$ a root of unity, and taking $m$ a common order gives $\{\lambda_i\}=\{1,\dots,1\}$.

vtrmc-2022-06.prompt: Let $f:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be a function whose second derivative is continuous. Suppose that $f$ and $f''$ are bounded. Show that $f'$ is also bounded.
vtrmc-2022-06.answer: Taylor: $f(x+1)=f(x)+f'(x)+\tfrac12f''(\xi)$, so $|f'(x)|\le2\sup|f|+\tfrac12\sup|f''|$. (Or: a large $f'(x_0)$ stays large on an interval and makes $f$ change too much.)
